title: Two days in Hoi An
pace: The old town, then the villages
summary: The old town on the first day. Tra Que, Thanh Ha, Cam Thanh, and Kim Bong on the second. An Bang is a separate half day.

days.title: Day 1 — Old town
days.body: The covered bridge, Tan Ky House, the halls, the market, and cao lầu.

days.title: Day 2 — The villages
days.body: Tra Que, Thanh Ha, and Kim Bong are each a morning. Cam Thanh is a boat hour. The fee there is 30,000 VND. How many of them fit is Check on arrival.

stops.name: Old town
stops.note: Day one. The bridge is about 20 minutes. The rest of the old-town day is on that plan.
